title: Even–Mansour recovery with quantum queries

problem.name_latex: Even--Mansour key recovery with quantum chosen plaintexts
problem.name: Even–Mansour key recovery with quantum chosen plaintexts
problem.statement_latex: Let $P$ be a public random permutation on $\{0,1\}^n$, and let $E(x)=P(x\oplus k_1)\oplus k_2$. Given coherent oracle access to both $E$ and $P$, recover $k_1,k_2$. The coherent chosen-plaintext access is part of this cryptographic model, commonly called Q2. The comparison counts coherent or classical oracle queries to the encryption and public permutation, with polynomial auxiliary quantum-gate and classical-bit costs.

quantum.headline_latex: $O(n)$ coherent queries and polynomial auxiliary time, Kuwakado--Morii and Simon period finding.
quantum.headline_text: $O(n)$ coherent queries and polynomial auxiliary time, Kuwakado–Morii and Simon period finding.
quantum.details_latex: The function $F(x)=E(x)\oplus P(x)$ has period $k_1$. The bounded-extra-collision analysis for a random public permutation supplies the success guarantee for Simon sampling; polynomial-time linear algebra recovers the period. One additional evaluation gives $k_2$. Coherent evaluation of both $E$ and $P$ is available in the stated Q2 model, so each sample has polynomial additional gates and two oracle evaluations.

classical.headline_latex: $\widetilde\Theta(2^n/D)$ public-permutation work with $D$ classical encryption queries, generic Even--Mansour attacks.
classical.headline_text: $\widetilde\Theta(2^n/D)$ public-permutation work with $D$ classical encryption queries, generic Even–Mansour attacks.
classical.details_latex: The time--data tradeoff has scale $TD\asymp2^n$, with $2\le D\le 2^n$ and total work including data acquisition. Minimizing $D+T$ gives the square-root total-work scale. The lower bound concerns the public random permutation and secret-key encryption access specified by the idealized construction.

strength.description_latex: Exponential to polynomial in $n$, from Simon period finding. This uses the XOR period created by the Even--Mansour construction and its coherent chosen-plaintext access.

hardware.description_latex: The algorithm needs polynomial logical qubits for the input, output and period equations, plus workspace for the public permutation and coherent encryption device. The depth is polynomial in $n$ times the oracle depth. Realizing the supplied coherent secret-key oracle is part of the hardware model.
